entries.title: On a Windows PC, infinitary link knows Infinitary is open
entries.body: When you run infinitary link or infinitary link --phone on a Windows PC while Infinitary is open but cannot make a link yet, as while it is still starting, it now says Infinitary is open here but did not answer. Before, it said Infinitary was not running.
entries.noPicture: The command answers in a terminal; nothing in the app's window changes.
